comment: Oil Smudge drags the colours it passes through. A 1200 by 1000 document on a grey ground carries 140 dots of 18 pixels in four hues on a 40 pixel grid, x 250 to 770 and y 120 to 480, and a flat band of one colour over the chunks of rows 2 and 3. Oil Smudge as it ships, at a radius of 100 pixels, is dragged left to right four times: through the dots at y 170 with Paint and Smudge switched off, which is the earlier reading, through them again at y 400 at the 50 percent the preset loads with, over the flat colour at y 640, and over it again at y 880 with the brush set to the flat colour itself. The dot row at y 280 lies between the two bands and no dab touches it, so the texel line along it reads the dots as laid. Before the fix every point of both dotted bands read one grey.
